scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Proves a two-target support-cardinality counterexample for a fixed but initially hidden target and iid nonadaptive reset durations, with exact rational proof checking. It establishes strict separation from every deterministic and exponential clock, not global optimality among arbitrary or adaptive randomized clocks. Proof and source comparisons have received self-review; independent scientific assessment and definitive priority verification have not been performed.
title: Two possible target distances suffice to make randomized restart strictly better than every fixed or Poisson clock
